verdict.rationale: First-party docs say the Gemini API analyzes multimodal inputs, and the quickstart covers multimodal understanding. The Live API accepts real-time voice and vision input, and gemini-embedding-2 maps text, images, video, audio and documents into one embedding space. Missing for 10: explicit docs for sending documents (e.g., PDFs) and audio files to the generation endpoint (document input is only evidenced for embeddings), detail on supported formats and limits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
